Integration bounds the full global map; strict exterior scaling plus interior derivative 1 prove finite-pair nonattainment. A constructive tangent direction approaches the bound. Child-count convexity proves path/star extremizers. The standalone checker passed all finite diagnostics.

Classical radial projection works concern same-norm radial maps, and tree total-variation research treats TV-energy minimization rather than this two-input global Lipschitz norm.
